content:
Two things:

1. **Tree unbuildable** — your in-flight let-chain conversion in `src/main.rs` (~8340-8366) is mid-edit with unbalanced braces (`if let Err(e) = mail.write_pane_identity(...) {` block at 8351 is missing a close). `cargo check` fails at 8366. I'm blocked on my test gate (l4s.2, state.rs, ready to verify). Land a compile-fixing commit when your chunk is stable — no rush on the last lint, just a compiling checkpoint.

2. **durable.rs** — I hold `src/state.rs` (granted) but `src/durable.rs` conflicts with your reservation. You're only on zbz.1 (clippy — no durable.rs files). Please release durable.rs so I can run cg6.2 (leaf-errors-soft-fail, P1, depends on my cg6.1). My regions: read_output/respawn call sites + their leaves only.
